chunks.text: Cynbit Technologies Private Limited is an unlisted private company incorporated on 2 April 2024, registered with RoC-Jaipur, status Active. Authorised capital INR 1,00,000; paid-up capital INR 30,000. Registered address: 32/115 Pratap Nagar, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302033.
Founders/directors listed in MCA-linked records: Ashutosh Upadhyay, Mohak Saini, Dhawan Kumar Nama.
Leadership: Mohak Saini (Founder & CEO), Ashutosh Upadhyay (Co-Founder), Dhawan Nama (Co-Founder & CTO). The page claims 100+ projects and 15+ architects.

Cynbit describes 2021 as preparation, 2022 as stress-testing with partners, and 2024 as official launch. Mission: build scalable, autonomous ecosystems that simplify complexity. Vision: global architectural benchmark for the digital age.

AI automation services: autonomous agents that manage leads and coordination; LLM automation of manual data entry and document handling; AI voice agents; AI stack integration into a client's existing SaaS stack.
Custom IT services: full-stack web and mobile development, backend systems (99.9% uptime claimed), cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure, legacy migration from monoliths to distributed systems.
Digital marketing services: performance ads (Google, Meta), technical SEO, CRM automation, funnel optimisation and landing pages.

Stated stack: TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, C++; React, Next.js, NestJS, FastAPI, Django, Tailwind; OpenAI, LangChain, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Pinecone, Spark; AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform; PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Prisma, Supabase, Neo4j.

Cynbit Studio: AI-powered career growth lab for students and developers. Features: placement assessment, adaptive coding paths, AI coding missions, AI code-quality evaluation, AI mentor hints, AI mock interviews, AI resume engine, job matcher analysis, XP and certificates (Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced), skill radar. USP: feedback on code quality rather than output matching.

TenantEase: property and tenant management SaaS. Unit tracking, tenant profiles with ID verification, rent tracking, automated payment reminders, payment audit history, business dashboard with occupancy and revenue trends. Target: property owners replacing notebooks and chat threads.

Revio: AI reputation and review management. Syncs reviews across Google and social platforms, generates AI replies, sentiment scoring, crisis detection, multi-location dashboard, role-based access (admin, manager, advisor). Aimed at multi-branch brands.

BitElevate: Cynbit's flagship training and internship programme for engineering students in Jaipur. Summer 2026 internship and training, durations of 4, 8 or 12 weeks, 16 selectable tracks (Full Stack, AI, ML, Data Science, Data Analytics, UI/UX, DevOps, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Blockchain, IoT, Deep Learning, NLP, Business Analytics, Digital Marketing, Social Media). Promoted as nominal-fee with a certificate. Claims 1000+ students trained, 450+ empowered, 88% placement, partner colleges incl. SKIT, JECRC, Poornima.
Observation: the BitElevate testimonials page uses placeholder-style avatar images, and the placement and student-count figures are unattributed. Treat them as marketing claims.

13 listed case studies: WizHealth (AI diagnostic triage), Pragya Healths (IoT remote patient monitoring), Wild Basil (blockchain-lite food supply chain transparency), Sofiasa (legacy ERP modernisation), EContentPrep (AI adaptive learning pathways), Cloudy Tales (real-time collaboration engine), Urban Wardrobe (AR virtual try-on), Evento (real-time ticketing), Marketing Addict (AI campaign optimisation), EliteVogue (headless commerce), TrendMart (hyper-local SEO), CarePlus Health (zero-downtime health data cloud migration), GlobalPay (cross-border payments). Mix: 8 software development, 3 cloud/other, 2 digital marketing. Healthcare and fashion/retail recur.

Careers page shows 20 live openings, remote or Jaipur: 12 internships (HR, business development, campus ambassador, social media, content, growth, digital marketing, QA, UI/UX, backend, AI/ML Engineer Intern, full stack) and 8 full-time roles (BD executive, content strategist, growth manager, marketing executive, DevOps/cloud, backend, AI engineer, full stack). Operating model: doc-led culture, asynchronous communication, iterative sprints, remote-first.

Blog publishes roughly monthly long-form (13-15 min) SEO-style posts in 2026: business automation tools, AI in digital marketing, web development trends, AI customer support, CRM automation, small-business AI automation. Claims a weekly newsletter with 25,000+ subscribers.

Social impact: BitElevate 1.0 builds technical skills; BitElevate 2.0 adds student wellbeing and mental health. Partnership with Manav Seva Trust teaching IT to government schools in rural areas. Claims 50k+ lives touched.

Instagram @cynbit.in (screenshot taken 17 Oct 2026): bio 'Dream Develop Deliver', category Product/service, 7 posts, 50 followers, 9 following. Visible posts: event photos at a Manav Seva Trust Rajasthan conference held in collaboration with the National Human Rights Commission; a 'Summer Internship & Training 2026' BitElevate poster offering 10% off the first registration (5 likes, 0 comments); a teaser for 'Studio' (Cynbit Studio launch teaser); another conference photo reel.

Latest carousel/reel caption (shared by the applicant; written in first person and attributed to co-founder Ashutosh Upadhyay): a reflective post on going from student to invited Chief Guest and guest speaker, launching BitElevate 2.0, collaborating with Manav Seva Trust, meeting National Human Rights Commission leadership, and giving guest lectures with Rajasthan University on computers and technology. Hashtags include BitElevate2, ManavSevaTrust, NHRC, GuestSpeaker, CynbitTechnologies. Signals: founder-led brand, college and institutional outreach, social-impact positioning.

SignalHire lists Cynbit at 10-50 employees, founded 2024, specialities including web and app development, digital marketing, blockchain, web3, mentorship, counselling. It also lists revenue of about 10.7M with no currency, which conflicts with registry capital figures; treat as unreliable.
The Manifest lists Cynbit as a small SEO and software company in Jaipur, 10-49 employees, launched 2024, minimum project size USD 1,000+, with no client reviews or key clients listed.

GitHub organisation Cynbit-Technologies describes the company as building AI, software engineering, automation, SaaS products and cloud infrastructure, and lists Cynbit Studio and BitElevate as products and initiatives.

LinkedIn company page (screenshot 17 Oct 2026): tagline 'AI-Powered. Future-Ready.', category IT Services and IT Consulting, Jaipur, 1.1K followers, 11-50 employees. Overview: a technology company specialising in IT services such as web development and app development. Listed services in the visible portion: Custom Software Development, SaaS Development, Web Development, Mobile Application Development, Digital Marketing, IT Consulting, Brand Consulting, Business Consulting, Career Development Coaching, Leadership Development.

Positioning observation: the website leads with AI automation and autonomous agents, but the visible LinkedIn overview and services list describe conventional web, app and SaaS development, marketing and consulting; AI appears mainly in the tagline. The service list also spans coaching and leadership development, so Cynbit sells to two audiences: businesses (software, AI, marketing) and students and professionals (BitElevate, coaching). Inbound messages therefore mix client leads with student, job and vendor enquiries, which makes triage a real operational need.

Not accessible or not found: LinkedIn post content and employee profiles (login wall), Reddit discussion (no results found), Instagram reel transcripts (video). No public financial statements or client reviews were found.

Likely revenue streams (inference, not disclosed): (1) project-based software, AI automation and marketing services for SMB clients; (2) SaaS subscriptions or demos for Studio, TenantEase and Revio; (3) BitElevate student programme fees and discounts; (4) possible institutional tie-ups with colleges. Evidence of scale is thin: 50 Instagram followers, 10-50 staff, paid-up capital INR 30,000.
